channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Global warming disrupts 400-year climate link between two oceans
item.description: The Indian and Pacific oceans have been climatically connected for centuries, but scientists say that link is now breaking down in an unusual way.

item.title: NASA-backed scientists convert plastic waste into edible cookies
item.description: Scientists have engineered yeast to transform PET plastic and agricultural waste into ingredients for protein-rich, 3D-printed cookies called µBites.

item.title: Study finds new genomic layer in Alzheimer's disease
item.description: Researchers discovered that DNA's 3D organization is disrupted in brain cells affected by Alzheimer's, altering the activity of key genes.

item.title: Physicists divided on fundamental workings of the Universe
item.description: A global survey of physicists found little consensus on major cosmic mysteries, with no majority supporting any single explanation.
